newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Earthquake hits Taiwan, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits Taiwan, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.3 on the Richter scale struck eastern and northeastern Taiwan early on Wednesday, but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
A Central Weather Bureau statement said the earthquake's epicentre was 8.9 km (5.5 miles) east of Taiwan's coastal city of Hualien and 28.9 km (17.9 miles) below the earth's surface.
There were no immediate reports of damage or casualties from the tremor, an interior ministry spokesman said.
The quake was felt in the capital Taipei where buildings swayed and in most parts of the island's eastern and northern region.
